other_conditions: Applicant must be the nominee or dependent of the deceased construction worker
The deceased construction worker must have been a citizen of India
The death must have occurred in an accident caused by the harness
The deceased must have been registered as a construction worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The deceased must have been at least 18 years old during his/her lifetime
The deceased must not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months while engaged in construction work
The deceased must have contributed regularly to the fund
The deceased must not have defaulted on contribution payments for a continuous period of more than one year
The application must be submitted within two months from the date of death of the construction worker
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,25,000 transferred directly to the nominee’s bank account
